# Skandiora Immigration

> Skandiora Immigration is an education guidance consultancy with offices in Trivandrum, Kochi and Chennai (South India). It helps students and families explore study-abroad, MBBS abroad, domestic admission, credit transfer, education loan, language training, attestation, accommodation and visa pathways — starting by understanding the student's academic background, ambitions, budget and eligibility rather than simply processing an application. Skandiora Immigration does not guarantee admission, loan approval or visa outcomes; these depend on the applicable institution, lender or immigration authority.

## Main services

- [Student Visa](/services/study-abroad): University, destination and course guidance plus student visa preparation for the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Dubai, Europe, Singapore and Mauritius.
- [Domestic Admission](/services/study-in-india): Domestic admission assistance across Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh.
- [Credit Transfer](/services/credit-transfer): Pathways for students with a discontinued degree to transfer credits to a recognised university.
- [Attestation](/services/attestation): Personal, educational, commercial and power-of-attorney document attestation assistance for international use. Enquire directly on WhatsApp; no website form.
- [Visa Services](/services/visa-assistance): Visiting visas for Dubai, Canada, UK, Australia and other destinations; spouse, family and dependent visas; PR options and other visa categories. Request a private consultation directly on WhatsApp. Student visas are covered under Study Abroad.

## Related & specialised services

- [MBBS Abroad](/services/mbbs-abroad): Medical admission guidance for Moldova, Bulgaria, Georgia, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kazakhstan and the USA — a specialised branch of the Student Visa / study-abroad service.
- [Education Loan Assistance](/services/education-loan): Documentation and application guidance for education financing, relevant to student visa applicants.
- [Language Training](/services/language-training): IELTS, TOEFL, OET and German exam preparation, relevant to student visa applicants.
- [Accommodation Assistance](/services/accommodation): Help exploring student accommodation before travel, relevant to visa services applicants.
